description: Adversaries may execute active reconnaissance scans to gather information that can be used during targeting. Active scanning is accomplished through probing victim infrastructure via network traffic, as opposed to other forms of reconnaissance that do not involve direct interaction.

pcaps.name: ICMP ping sweep
pcaps.description: ICMP echo requests to multiple hosts to identify active systems.

pcaps.name: TCP port scan
pcaps.description: Comprehensive TCP port scan across multiple ports.

pcaps.name: UDP port scan
pcaps.description: UDP port scan with ICMP unreachable responses.

pcaps.name: Service enumeration
pcaps.description: Service version detection and enumeration attempts.

pcaps.name: OS fingerprinting
pcaps.description: OS detection attempts using TCP/IP fingerprinting.

pcaps.name: Banner grabbing
pcaps.description: Banner grabbing attempts to identify service versions.
